concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a bright and airy conference room with a diverse team of professionals seated around a wooden table, warm lighting, pastel color palette, friendly mood, eye-level camera angle, and a cityscape outside the window. The team is engaged in a discussion with laptops and notes open.
concepts.title: Diverse Business Team Meeting Room

concepts.description: A young woman is meditating on a rock in a misty forest, with her eyes closed and hands on her knees, surrounded by lush greenery and a peaceful atmosphere.
